formal_statement: ∀ (M k : ℕ) (W : Submodule ℂ (Fin M → ℂ)), 2 ≤ k → (∀ j : ℕ, 2 ≤ j → j ≤ k → ∀ x ∈ W, ∑ i, x i ^ j = 0) → k * Module.finrank ℂ W ≤ M
plain_statement: If W in C^M is a linear subspace with sum x_i^j = 0 for every x in W and every j from 2 to k (k >= 2), then k dim W <= M. k = 2 is the isotropic bound, k = 3 is L-gct-061. Proof plan: polarize; V = W + W^2 + .. + W^(k-1) is orthogonal to W; split along the stabilizer of V; on a block the stabilizers of all intermediate products are trivial, so Kneser for codes (L-gct-065, checked) applied k - 2 times gives dim V >= (k-1) dim W. Conjecture of this project until checked; the generalization of L-gct-061 asked for by strategy.
title: Iterated Fermat lemma: a complex linear space on which the power sums p2, .., pk all vanish has dimension at most M/k
